meta.name: The Conjuring The Devil Made Me Do It
meta.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren encounter what would become one of the most sensational cases from their files. The fight for the soul of a young boy takes them beyond anything they'd ever seen before, to mark the first time in U.S. history that a murder suspect would claim demonic possession as a defense.
meta.slogan: The demonic case that shocked America.
